# Account-name vectors, shared by auth's canonical rule and the SMB agent's copy
# of it.
#
# The two packages sit in the same tier and may not import each other, so the
# parity that keeps them from drifting is proved through this file rather than
# through a shared function. Each side reads it and asserts its own rule agrees
# with the verdict recorded here.
#
# Format: a verdict, a tab, then the name with Go escaping. A line starting with
# a hash is a comment; the name is never empty except in the one vector that
# tests emptiness, which is written as an empty quoted string.

valid	"alice"
valid	"bob"
valid	"a"
valid	"_svc"
valid	"user-1"
valid	"a_b-c9"
valid	"x9"
valid	"_"
valid	"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
valid	"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
invalid	""
invalid	"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
invalid	"Alice"
invalid	"ALICE"
invalid	"aliceB"
invalid	"1alice"
invalid	"-alice"
invalid	"9"
invalid	"-"
invalid	".alice"
invalid	"/alice"
invalid	"al ice"
invalid	"al:ice"
invalid	"al\tice"
invalid	"al,ice"
invalid	"-oProxyCommand=x"
invalid	"--help"
invalid	"-x"
invalid	"alice\u00ff"
invalid	"ali\u20acce"
invalid	"\u00e1lice"
invalid	"alice."
invalid	"alice$"
invalid	"alice+"
invalid	"alice="
invalid	"alice*"
invalid	"alice'"
invalid	"alice\""
invalid	"alice`"
invalid	"alice;"
invalid	"alice|"
invalid	"alice&"
invalid	"alice("
invalid	"alice)"
invalid	"a.b@c"
invalid	"alice@example"
invalid	"alice+tag"
valid	"root"
valid	"nobody"
valid	"smbguest"
